label: Stone Bridge
literalRoomDescription: This is the middle of a ruined but still impressive stone bridge spanning a deep chasm. Water flows far beneath. A paved path leads north into a large open space. To the south, the path leads into a misty tunnel.
safeSceneProfile: Ruined impressive stone bridge over deep chasm, water far below, north paved approach and south misty tunnel. Do not reuse wooden footbridge appearance here.
